title: 1 Chronicles Bible Quiz - Chapter 17
description: Ten questions on 1 Chronicles 17: David's wish to build a house for God, Yahweh's promise through Nathan and David's prayer.

questions.text: To whom did David say, "I dwell in a house of cedar, but the ark of Yahweh's covenant is in a tent"?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 17:1 says David spoke these words to Nathan the prophet.

questions.text: What was Nathan's first answer to David?
questions.explanation: Nathan said to David, "Do all that is in your heart; for God is with you."

answers.text: "Do all that is in your heart; for God is with you."
"You are a man of war; do not build."

questions.text: When did the word of God come to Nathan?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says the word of God came to Nathan that same night.

questions.text: How does God describe the way he had lived since he brought up Israel?
questions.explanation: God said he had not lived in a house but had gone from tent to tent, and from one tent to another.

questions.text: From where did Yahweh say he had taken David to be prince over Israel?
questions.explanation: Yahweh of Armies said, "I took you from the sheep pen, from following the sheep, to be prince over my people Israel."

answers.text: From the land of the Philistines

questions.text: What did Yahweh tell David that Yahweh would build for him?
questions.explanation: Verse 10 says, "Moreover I tell you that Yahweh will build you a house."

questions.text: According to Yahweh's promise, who would build God a house?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said he would set up David's offspring after him, one of his sons, and "he will build me a house."

answers.text: Nathan the prophet after David's death
Hiram king of Tyre and his masons
The Levites and the elders of Israel
David's offspring, one of his sons

questions.text: What did Yahweh say about David's offspring in verse 13?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "I will be his father, and he will be my son. I will not take my loving kindness away from him."

answers.text: He will be a prophet like Nathan
He will rule only for forty years
He will never go to war

questions.text: What did King David do after Nathan spoke all these words to him?
questions.explanation: David the king went in and sat before Yahweh, and said, "Who am I, Yahweh God, and what is my house?"

answers.text: He went in and sat before Yahweh
He called for the elders of Israel

questions.text: Why did David say he had found courage to pray before God?
questions.explanation: David said God had revealed to his servant that he would build him a house; therefore he had found courage to pray.

answers.text: Because the ark was in the tent
Because God revealed he would build him a house
